thread:
eli: Quick heads-up: we're releasing SDK v3.0-beta with a new "output_contract_enforcement" behavior enabled by default for generation/chat. This tightens how we validate structured responses and will return a parse error instead of best-effort fixes.

noah: Will this break existing apps?

eli: Potentially for apps that relied on heuristic fixes. We recommend running the migration tests linked below. If you need old behavior, set `REDWOOD_OUTPUT_CONTRACT=off` or client option `output_contract_enforcement=false`.

rachel: Docs & migration guide?

eli: Migration guide live: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/v3/migration-output-contract. It includes quick checks and sample prompts.

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-2040 "v3 output contract KB updates" and assigned to Support Docs.

deploy-bot: docs: published v3 migration page  status: live :white_check_mark:

noah: Dedicated/private rollout plan?

eli: Hosted flips for new signups immediately; existing hosted orgs get 90-day opt-out window. Dedicated pools can set runtime flag `allow_heuristics=true` for 120 days. Private operators receive an operator patch and rollout notes in the private repo.

rachel: Telemetry?

eli: Added metric `sdk.output_contract.enforcement_errors` and a dashboard. Alerts if enforcement_errors > 5x baseline for an org within 1h.

eli: Action items: update starter repos, support KB, and notify big structured-output customers. Ping me for help with tests.
